{{Quote|This shrouded prophecy will come to pass. The foundations will be shaken, the pillars razed... the chaos is unavoidable.|Neeka-Bo|<ref name="OW">{{TORcite|Mission: "Old Wounds" on [[Interpreter's Retreat]]}}</ref>}}
'''Neeka-Bo''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] female that was a member of the [[Three]] during [[3624 BBY]]. During that same year, the [[Alliance Commander]] came to visit the three to discuss the plans of [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="OW" />
